note.en: Hover over or tap a place for my take and what to order.
note.sr: Pređi mišem preko mesta ili ga dodirni za moj komentar i šta da naručiš.

note.en: Best sushi in the city, by far.
Great pasta and a great quality/price ratio.
note.sr: Odlična pasta i odličan odnos cene i kvaliteta.

note.en: Best pizza in the city. The thinnest you'll find.
note.sr: Najbolja pica u gradu. Tanju nećeš naći.

note.en: Great pljeskavica. Was S, but fell off.
note.sr: Odlična pljeskavica. Bio je S, ali je pao.

note.en: Good, but the prices are a bit exaggerated.
note.sr: Dobro, ali su cene malo preterane.

note.en: Great food at a steep price.

try.en: The rabbit. The beef Wellington is also pristine.
try.sr: Zeca. I beef Wellington je besprekoran.

try.en: The gnocchi with cheese. A must.

note.en: Fair food at a fair price. Great for dinners where the food isn't the topic: the view is the selling point.
note.sr: Pošteno jelo po poštenoj ceni. Odličan za večere na kojima hrana nije tema: pogled je glavni adut.

note.en: Good sushi at a fair enough price.
note.sr: Dobar suši po sasvim pristojnoj ceni.

note.en: Good enough, with some interesting flavours.
note.sr: Sasvim solidno, ima neke zanimljive ukuse.

note.en: The atmosphere tries to be authentic, but doesn't succeed.
note.sr: Atmosfera pokušava da bude autentična, ali ne uspeva.

try.en: The beef tartare, but split it four ways: it's too big.
try.sr: Goveđi tartar, ali ga podelite na četvoro: prevelik je.
